title: Plug-in compatibility: Custom Web Publishing
description: Plug-in function calls in scope that do not run on Custom Web Publishing: MBS functions whose documentation marks Server=No (verbatim platform flags from the MBS docs mirror, interpreted onto this environment via the curated runtime map - scripts here execute under the FileMaker Server script engine). Includes one-level custom-function wrappers (via_custom_function) and layout/field calculation usages (evidence_kind='layout'). Functions of a known plugin without a doc entry appear as explicit 'unresolved' info rows.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Plug-in functions whose MBS documentation marks Server=No are unavailable under the FileMaker Server script engine, which executes scripts for this environment. The mapping is a curated interpretation with per-row provenance (plugin_runtime_map).
rule.remediation: Guard or replace the call for this runtime (e.g. branch on Get(Device)/execution context, or move the interactive part to a client script). Unresolved functions: update the MBS docs mirror (install-mbs-docs) and re-derive the plugin platform map.
